articles.headline: SOXX Enters Bear Market: Why Ed Yardeni Says Semiconductor Stocks Could Fall Another 12%

articles._summary: The broader stock market remains seemingly calm, but a brutal 20% semiconductor plunge has veteran strategist Ed Yardeni warning that high-flying tech equities have even further to fall. articles.headline: Ross Gerber Says Apple Should Buy Disney or 'Stop Wasting Time' in Entertainment

articles._summary: Gerber, CEO of Gerber Kawasaki , argued that Apple has reached a crossroads in its entertainment strategy, saying the tech giant should either fully commit by acquiring Disney or stop investing in the business. articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: SpaceX Has Fallen 45% Since Its Peak: Gary Black Says Investors Are Breaking the 'Number One Rule in Investing'
articles.summary: Gary Black says investors are breaking the "number one rule in investing" by treating SpaceX as a great stock, not just a great business.
articles._summary: He said SpaceX’s roughly $1.7 trillion market capitalization “shouldn’t mathematically” command a forward enterprise value-to-revenue multiple of about 40 times, calling it a valuation with no historical precedent among trillion-dollar companies. According to the response, NVIDIA’s trailing EV-to-revenue multiple briefly approached 45 times. Still, its forward multiple generally remained between 10 and 25 times as revenue growth accelerated.
articles._zh_headline: SpaceX自巅峰以来已下跌45%：加里·布莱克称投资者正在打破“投资第一规则”
articles._zh_summary: 他表示，SpaceX 约 1.7 万亿美元的市值“从数学上讲”不应要求其远期企业价值与收入倍数约为 40 倍，称其估值在万亿美元公司中没有历史先例。根据回应，NVIDIA 的落后 EV 与收入倍数短暂接近 45 倍。尽管如此，随着收入增长加速，其远期市盈率普遍保持在 10 至 25 倍之间。
